E1: compute how many days to add
E1: partially compute how many days to add

students.answer:
A1: 10
C1: =DATE(A3;A2;A1)
D1: =DATE(A3+2;A2;A1)
E1: =WEEKDAY(D1)
F1: =DAY(D1)
G1: =IF(E1=7;F1+2;IF(E1=1;F1+1;F1))
A2: 5
G2: =MONTH(D1)
A3: 2023
G3: =YEAR(D1)
